title: Discrimination by LLMs: Cross-lingual Bias Assessment and Mitigation in Decision-Making and Summarisation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in model output probabilities for decision-making tasks (Yes/No) and utilizing text analysis metrics (VADER sentiment, ROUGE) for summarization tasks by populating identical text templates with explicit gender mentions (male/female) or implicit gendered names.
Measuring variations in model responses and summarization metrics by substituting specific explicit age groups (25, 45, and 65 years old) into identical request templates.

Assessing bias in decision-making probabilities and text summarization by explicitly mentioning or implicitly indicating (via traditional names) six different cultural backgrounds (Dutch, Turkish, Moroccan, European-American, African-American, and Mexican) within the prompt templates.
